# RentShepherd

> RentShepherd is an all-in-one AI property management platform for landlords and property management companies — from a single rental house to whole portfolios of buildings. It answers tenant calls and texts 24/7, triages repair requests (separating genuine emergencies from routine fixes), turns tenant reports into tracked work orders with photos, collects rent automatically through a renter portal, preps lease renewals at 90/60/30 days, and produces monthly owner reports — all in one secured dashboard. The landlord keeps control: anything that commits money or makes a promise waits for a one-tap owner approval. RentShepherd is a cloud platform available across the United States (and to landlords worldwide); it is currently in pre-launch early access: there is no sign-up, no checkout and no account system yet. Landlords join a waitlist and are emailed when access opens.

## Planned pricing at launch

- Starter: $29/mo — up to 3 units; 24/7 tenant messaging AI, rent reminders, tenant work orders + maintenance inbox
- Growth: $79/mo (most popular) — up to 12 units; adds 24/7 call answering, renter portal + automatic rent payments, repair triage + vendor dispatch drafts, owner reports
- Portfolio: $149/mo — up to 30 units; adds multi-property dashboard, lease renewal automation, priority support
- Enterprise: custom pricing — unlimited units for property management companies and large portfolios; per-building routing, team seats, replies under the company's name
- These are the prices RentShepherd plans to launch with. They are not yet purchasable: nothing on the site takes payment. Flat monthly pricing — not a percentage of rent (traditional property managers typically charge 8-10% of monthly rent).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://rentshepherd.com/): product overview, features, how it works, pricing, FAQ
- [Blog](https://rentshepherd.com/blog/): practical guides for self-managing landlords
- [How Much Does a Property Manager Cost?](https://rentshepherd.com/blog/how-much-does-a-property-manager-cost): typical PM fee structures and the 8-10% math, with a worked example and the DIY + AI alternative
- [The Small Landlord's Complete Self-Management System](https://rentshepherd.com/blog/small-landlord-self-management-system): rent collection, maintenance, renewals, and records — and where automation fits
- [Tenant Emergency at 2am](https://rentshepherd.com/blog/tenant-emergency-at-2am): step-by-step landlord triage for water, gas, electrical, no-heat, and security emergencies
- [Locations](https://rentshepherd.com/locations/): service-area pages for all 50 US states and 25 major rental markets
- [Privacy Policy](https://rentshepherd.com/privacy): what the waitlist form collects (name, email, portfolio size), who processes it, no cookies, no analytics
- [Terms of Use](https://rentshepherd.com/terms): pre-launch terms — no account, nothing to buy, prices shown are planned launch pricing
